verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents a full agent-checkout pipeline: 'Agent Checkouts' let an agent buy from any merchant via a single API with a spending cap (crossmint-docs-4, crossmint-supp-7), delegated payment credentials via Agent Cards (order intent/allowance, one-time card numbers, network verification) or Agent Wallets (onchain-enforced scoped delegation) (crossmint-supp-2, crossmint-supp-3, crossmint-supp-4), and order lifecycle tracking through polling to a terminal state (crossmint-supp-7). This covers checkout session, delegated credential, and confirmed order end-to-end as first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and the docs themselves note checkout v1 lacks webhooks/staging, meaning production confirmation flow is poll-only and unverified by outside sources.
